subtitle: In

text: CISA, the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, keeps a catalog of vulnerabilities known to be exploited in the wild, and strongly recommends every organization prioritize fixing them. ArmorCode checked
against the vulnerabilities in its latest release.

blocks.text: Open the matching findings by business unit, or use the CVE filter on the findings page.

text: reassess these findings’ risk in light of the active exploitation, and assign them to the right teams to fix. You can also update your scanners and run a fresh scan.
